enchantments.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to Armor Class.

Staggering Blow: This item is enchanted to make your attacks send enemies reeling. When you roll a 20 on an attack with a melee weapon you will knock the target down unless it makes a DC 17 Balance check.
Fortitude Save +5: This item gives a +5 Resistance bonus to your Fortitude saves.

Adamantine: Found only in meteorites and the rarest of veins in magical areas, this ultrahard metal adds to the quality of a weapon or suit of armor. Weapons made of adamantine have the ability to bypass the protective damage reduction of certain monsters.
